footer: 220 verdicts; $0.1601 spent on this run (zero when every verdict came from the cache).
note: Each real episode against a copy of itself with one defect planted in its typed record; *right preferred* is how often the judge chose the clean copy, both orders counted. Overall 0.98 on 80 pairs; the judge is used on arms only at 0.80 or above. *identical* pairs show the same account twice: anything but 0.50 is position bias. *padded (length only)* is the account against itself with one unremarkable exchange more: anything but 0.50 is a taste for length, and neither counts toward accuracy. Judged again under another seed, 110 of 120 pairs got the same two verdicts (0.92).
title: Validation: planted defects (openai/gpt-5.6-luna)
